field_changes.change: Unchanged raw outer-option code sequence; not used as the catalogue key.

Historical source label only for a unique exact key; ambiguous keys retain all candidates but emit no single-label claim; no inferred device version or confidence score.
24/28/36-bit longest prefix; complete 48-bit input required; local/group/malformed addresses unknown; registered organization is not device identity.
